suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add max_revisions to the Configuration table. It controls the evaluator revision cycle limit (default 1, env var FLYWHEEL_MAX_REVISIONS, range 0-5). This is distinct from max_retries which controls transport retries (default 3). The feature that fixed the max_retries/max_revisions confusion bug highlighted that this config key is undocumented.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Config schema at src/config/loader.ts:83 defines max_revisions with default 1. Feature misc-cleanup-broken-scripts fixed a bug where max_retries (default 3) was incorrectly used for evaluator revision cycles instead of max_revisions (default 1).
